usedFor: Asana holds tasks and AI Studios by Deep Brain writes text, so “Create Text Generator” can follow task activity.

bestTemplate.name: “New Story Added to Task or Goal” in Asana, then “Create Text Generator” in AI Studios by Deep Brain
bestTemplate.why: Each new comment or activity on a task can supply the topic for generated text.

watchOut: “New Story Added to Task or Goal” is polling and watches one task or goal, so expect a delay.
